lines.en: I trot with my head held up.

lines.zh: 我的身子很轻，跑起来像风。
lines.en: My body is light; I run like wind.
I move along the woodland edge.
I scan as I go.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴直直地伸在后面。
lines.en: My tail stretches straight behind me.

lines.zh: 我从低矮的灌木间穿过。
lines.en: I slip between the low shrubs.

lines.zh: 我踩着枯枝，只响了一下。
lines.en: I step on a dry twig; one crack.
I cut between trunk and trunk.
I head toward where the smell comes from.
Two steps, then a look.
I jog along an animal trail.
My claws catch the ground easily.
I keep low and move fast.
Standing with my neck stretched long.

lines.zh: 我在听林子里的每个声音。
lines.en: I'm listening to every sound in the wood.
My slim tail keeps me balanced.
My head sweeps slowly around.

lines.zh: 我在数前面的路有几条。
lines.en: I'm counting the paths ahead.

lines.zh: 我的皮肤上有细细的纹。
lines.en: Fine lines run over my skin.
I crouch by a tree root.
I hold perfectly still, like a stick.
My tail taps the ground lightly.
I hear something very far.
I'm still here, waiting.
You're quite a bit bigger than me.
My gaze has stayed stuck on you.
If you run, I won't keep up.
You make far too much noise.
I'm weighing whether it's worth a try.
I don't mean to pounce first.
I'm more agile than you.
Your hands smell of raw meat.
I sprang two steps away.
Limping, I can still chase two steps.
A wound this small is serious for me.
I duck behind a tree.
My light frame sways but doesn't fall.
My head keeps turning.
I ease off for a moment.
I can still walk on my own.
Is that meat?
It is one small piece. Not enough.

lines.zh: 我不吃活的东西给的东西。
lines.en: I don't take food from the living.
Let me check around first.
The smell of blood drifts from your sleeve.
Loosen your grip on it first.

lines.zh: 你手里的肉味，比逃跑更诱人。
lines.en: The meat in your hand is more tempting than running.

lines.zh: 同伴都在看，我可不想错过这口。
lines.en: The pack is watching; I won't miss this bite.
You bumped me.
One twist and I slip clear.
My body is too light.
You nearly pinned me underfoot.
I spring back two steps.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴被夹在树枝里。
lines.en: My tail caught in a branch.
It took two pulls to get loose.
You're blocking my route.
I'm too light to knock you over.
Several of us run together.
They're a little faster than me.
We move spread out.
Whoever spots prey calls first.
We close in around that tree.
It looks thinner than me.
We never get too close.
One call, and we all scatter.
It took my spot.
I go look elsewhere.
I gulped it down whole.
I can't drag this.
What's on the ground is mine.
I sniff it; not interested.

lines.zh: 森林的小恐龙，爪下按住。
lines.en: The forest runner pins it under a claw.
The skull still hangs at my mouth.

lines.zh: 那块肉掉在地上，现在归我了。
lines.en: That meat on the ground is mine now.

lines.zh: 我叼起掉落物，转身就跑。
lines.en: I snatch up the dropped thing and bolt.
That thing just moved.
My neck stretches forward, muscles tight.

lines.zh: 我的第一步已经跨出去。
lines.en: My first step is already taken.
I'm fast from this angle.
The bushes hide my shadow.

lines.zh: 三只同伴断了它的退路。
lines.en: Three packmates cut off its retreat.
We run in packs of three or five.
I've stopped breathing.
No call; I just go.
Too close — it heard me.
I need a new angle.
My slender legs kick off and I lunge.
I'm off.
It was slow to start.
I trail along the ground.
I stay off its rear flank.
It turns; I cut the corner.
It can run longer than I can.
I wait for it to stop and pant.
I've changed direction three times.
Its shadow stays ahead of me.
I try to make no sound.
The roots keep me covered.
Only a few trees separate us.
It runs for the gap in the trees.
This is the last straight stretch.
A little faster.
I stay right on its tail.
I hear it snap a branch.
I leap and rake once.
My teeth are fine and sharp.
That bite lands on its leg.
It shakes me off.
I pull back to see how it reacts.
That bite didn't take hold.
I lunge the same way again.
Its hide is thicker than I expected.
I have bitten down; my teeth are locked.
It hits a tree and I let go.
That's enough for a meal.
In the end I still withdrew.
I watch it from under a tree.
I rise up among the ferns.

lines.zh: 林子里有我这样的东西。
lines.en: There are things like me in this wood.
There are many smells here.
I shake out my limbs.
My head turns this way and that.
I test the ground lightly.
Wind moves between the trees.
I keep myself as low as I can.

lines.zh: 我看见地上有新的印子。
lines.en: I see fresh tracks on the ground.
This ground works for me.
My first step is especially careful.
There's a sound ahead.
I stand and wait a while.
I'm ready to give chase.
Fire comes and I dive into the grass.
I drop out of a tree, dazed.
Water up my nose; I thrash.
Fern fronds stick all over me.
An arrow passes through my leg.
Light pins me under the tree.
No prey, and I keep getting lighter.
The thunder sends me into a hole.
